card.name: Prognostic and predictive factor wording
card.fires_on: The word "factors" after "prognostic", or "predictive" before "markers" or "of", in clinical trial or lab-monitoring statements about what does or does not forecast outcomes.

modes.label: Prognostic factors
modes.description: The word "factors" right after "prognostic" in trial results or dose-adjustment text.
modes.example: Other prognostic<< factors>>, such as histologic subtype, grade

modes.label: Predictive as a modifier
modes.description: The word "predictive" after "reliable" or "not", describing markers or scores that forecast an outcome.
modes.example: NSS are not<< predictive>> of onset of psychiatric symptoms.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a text names things that predict or forecast a patient's outcome, such as prognostic factors.
